flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Intermittent faults on a schedule. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p15-bursts

processGroups.comments: For 20 minutes every second hour a campaign burst adds 20/s to 2/s of web events, into a loader that does 10/s: its queue fills, drains in the quiet hour, and fills again. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S35 Bursts Overwhelm The Loader

processGroups.comments: For ten minutes each hour the partner export runs, and its validator auto-terminates the quarter of its records that fail: they vanish, and only while the export runs. (symptom: data_loss)
processGroups.name: S36 Hourly Bad Partner Records
